critical_code_review_comments: reactivation_routes.py:501-553 — new async generate_conversation_script correctly: (a) rejects non-COMPLETED members with 409, (b) creates a placeholder generated_materials row with status='Generating' BEFORE starting the background task so a concurrent POST hits the duplicate-guard, (c) uses asyncio.create_task rather than blocking the request, (d) on exception writes status='Failed' + generation_error. Contract verified from external URL: POST 0.10s → poll → Draft in ~65s.

reactivation_routes.py:540-552 — run_generation() has no timeout wrapper around generate_structured(); if Claude hangs indefinitely the material stays 'Generating' with no failure signal. Consider wrapping in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=300).

reactivation_routes.py:552 — asyncio.create_task is fire-and-forget; the task reference is not stored, so if the event loop is under GC pressure it could theoretically be cancelled. Low risk in practice but tracking the task in a set (background_tasks.add(t); t.add_done_callback(background_tasks.discard)) is safer.

ReactivationStep3.jsx:45-59 pollForScript — 60 attempts × 4s = 240s max wait matches or exceeds observed generation time (~65s). Silently breaks on request failure without surfacing an error toast; a rare mid-poll 500 would look like a completed generation to the user. Minor.
ReactivationStep3.jsx:69-72 mount-resume useEffect — correctly resumes polling if the row is loaded already in Generating state (e.g., user navigated away and back). Good.

ReactivationStep3.jsx:155 — action buttons correctly gated on !['Generating','Failed'].includes(scriptStatus) && busy !== 'generate'. Verified in browser: buttons hidden during generation, visible again on Draft.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the iter35 502: reactivation_routes.py generate_conversation_script() was awaiting generate_structured() synchronously (~65-70s Claude call for a 13-section nested schema), exceeding the Kubernetes/nginx ingress 60s upstream_response_timeout. Fix (verified): the endpoint now (1) upserts a generated_materials row with status='Generating' before returning, (2) schedules run_generation() as an asyncio background task, (3) returns {material_id, status:'Generating'} in <1s. run_generation() calls generate_structured() then save_reactivation_material() which pushes the new version and flips status to 'Draft'; on exception it writes status='Failed' + generation_error. The frontend polls every 4s and gates action buttons on status. Duplicate-guard: if an existing material is already 'Generating', POST returns the existing material_id without launching a second Claude call. Verified end-to-end over the public URL: kickoff 0.10s, Draft reached after ~65s, no 502 at any point.
